items.summary: The finance ministry is launching a campaign to saturate financial schemes across various local bodies. items.title: Saudi Arabia keen on enhanced ties with India on power grid systems
items.summary: Saudi Arabia has expressed interest in cooperating with India on extra-high-voltage electricity transmission systems. The focus includes managing renewable energy integration to meet rising power demands. A virtual meeting took place between officials from both countries to discuss these initiatives. Technical cooperation aims to address challenges in electricity needs for data centres and grid codes. Ongoing discussions will continue on electrical interconnection and additional cooperation areas.

items.title: RBI tightens scrutiny of $1 billion-plus overseas investments amid rupee pressure
items.summary: The Reserve Bank of India is implementing stricter scrutiny on large overseas direct investments by Indian companies. Banks must now collect and present detailed information regarding these investments to the RBI. This initiative aims to prevent potential losses for both the companies and the Indian economy. The RBI's checklist requires banks to conduct thorough due diligence on the rationale behind each investment.

items.summary: Consumers in Gurugram and Nuh will be able to select between two power distribution companies soon. Eleven Power Pvt Ltd has been granted a 25-year license to supply electricity in these districts. The existing utility will remain available for consumers alongside Eleven Power. A detailed plan for execution and consumer switching procedures must be submitted within 60 days.

items.title: Hedge funds retreat from tech at fastest pace in a decade as AI trade weakens

items.title: Ferrari accelerates India expansion, opens doors to EU trade pact benefits

Ferrari’s CEO emphasized the importance of developing relationships with Indian customers and enthusiasts. The automaker has also unveiled an electric vehicle at its first exhibition in India.

The net profit increased significantly to ₹6,412 crore compared to the previous year.

Additionally, delays in red chilli sowing in Andhra Pradesh and Telangana could lead to surging market prices.
